summary.motive: Attack the perimeter with a full-speed motion back so the pitch arrives at maximum velocity before the defense can reset its force geometry.
summary.whyItWorks: The motion outruns defensive flow calls, and sequential kick-outs on end, linebacker, and safety force every edge defender outward while the carrier turns north.
summary.failureMode: The force safety squeezes the pitch track instead of taking the kick-out, or the ends spill the blockers and funnel the sweep back inside.

beats.title: 1. Rocket Motion at Full Speed
beats.text: The slot crosses the formation at a dead sprint instead of shimmy-shifting. By the time the defense diagnoses direction he is already even with the tackles.

beats.title: 2. The Extended Pitch
beats.text: The quarterback reverse-pivots and extends the pitch all the way to the edge, handing the ball to H at top gear without breaking his stride.

beats.title: 3. Kick-Out Geometry
beats.text: B kicks the end inside while the guard leads on the linebacker and A climbs to the force safety. Every defender who could squeeze the edge is being blocked outward.

beats.title: 4. The Perimeter Edge
beats.text: With the force player kicked out and both corners stalked, H turns upfield into grass with escorts leading him to the numbers.

relations.tell: The pitch is extended laterally to a moving back at full speed — option triples hand or ride stationary before reading.
